findings.summary: B6 is not concurrent, violating the spec's explicit "⛔ 不得串行化". The N renders are produced by `Array.from({length: N}, () => runDriver(...))`, and `runDriver` uses `execFileSync` (test/a10b-convergence.test.ts:67), which blocks synchronously. The six renders therefore execute strictly one after another despite the `procs` variable name and the "不串行化" comment. B6 is the only criterion targeting the actual §0.2 defect — concurrent renders overwriting each other's `fleet.yaml` under vitest's parallel file execution — so as written it has zero power against the interleaving it claims to detect, and the per-render read-back loop cannot collide because each serialized render already has a unique RUN_ROOT.

`runRealE2E` calls `startFakeBus(opts.port, opts.seedPath)` without `await`, discarding the promise that polls the port for readiness (test/a10b-convergence.test.ts:99-125). The very next statement is a blocking `execFileSync` of the driver, so the readiness loop's `await fetch` can never run before the driver starts reading the bus. B1 and B2 thus race the fake bus's startup, reintroducing exactly the acceptance-command nondeterminism this package exists to eliminate (§0.2, B8). The dropped promise also means a bus that fails to bind within 5000ms surfaces as an unhandled rejection rather than a loud test failure, which is the silent-zero-result pattern §3.2 forbids.

§2.1 requires recording the pre-run and post-run message-count delta in dev-notes and requires that delta be ≤ `--max-writes`. The dev-notes contain no message counts at all. Relatedly, B1/B2 were not executed against the real evidence channel `research:p02-smoke-1dce60.evidence` that the gate created on 2026-08-05 09:27Z specifically so B2 "不再放宽"; they ran against a 106-line in-memory fake HTTP bus (test/fixtures/fake-bus.mjs) reached via a new `AGENT_BUS_URL` override. Substituting the entire bus service leaves the real end-to-end publish path unverified, and the dev-notes' claim of "不打桩" is inconsistent with introducing that fixture.

The convergence fix is limit tuning rather than a fix of the diagnosed defect, and it is unguarded. The dev-notes correctly identify the root cause as the fleet's `claim.complete` mapping treating every terminal reason outside {halt, drained} as a failure and routing it to `failure_status: open`, but the change only raises `limits.max_nodes` from 1 to 2 so that a single-node pass no longer reports `reason="max_nodes"`. The misclassification in workflows/deep-research/fleet.yaml.tpl:20-22 is untouched, so convergence breaks again the moment a tick pass completes two or more nodes — `done.size >= max_nodes` re-triggers `reason="max_nodes"`, the seed is routed back to `open`, and drain returns to the `max_rounds` behaviour of §0.1. A caller-side general fix was available without touching the loop-engine repo (§4), and no test pins either `max_nodes >= 2` or the completion mapping, so no criterion would catch the regression.

B1's `expect(code).toBe(0)` is tautological: `runRealE2E` hardcodes `return { code: 0, out: res, err: "" }` and has no non-zero path, since `execFileSync` throws instead. The assertion can never fail and adds no power to the criterion.

B8 requires recording five exit codes from five consecutive full-suite runs, all zero. The dev-notes assert the result with a bare checkmark and record no exit codes, so the claim is unverifiable from the committed evidence.

§3.1.4 requires that the N3 mutation be run at least 5 times with at least one failure asserted, because the RUN_ID race is probabilistic. The dev-notes record only a single run ("亲跑 B5 挂"). This matters because B5 under a seconds-granularity RUN_ID is itself probabilistic: two consecutive renders straddling a second boundary still yield distinct RUN_ROOTs, so one green run does not establish that N3 was killed.
